corePassives.description:
When Soi Fon releases the Special Attack - Time's Up or Battlefield Skill - Twin-Strike Execution, she inflicts the enemy with Execution Target for 15 seconds. During this time, whenever the enemy is attacked by any character, an extra Sting equal to 55% of Soi Fon's ATK is triggered. Cooldown: 2 seconds. 
 
  Tapping Basic Attack after Soi Fon's Perfect Dodge, or her icon after a teammate's Perfect Dodge, triggers Windmill. Cooldown: 14 seconds.
corePassives.name: Execution Begins

corePassives.description: Reduces the Strike Resistance of enemies inflicted with Execution Target by 20%.
corePassives.name: Nowhere to Escape

corePassives.description: When any character in the team triggers a Perfect Dodge, the entire team gains 15% ATK for 25 seconds. Unstackable. This bonus is 30% for Yoruichi.
corePassives.name: Blink

corePassives.description: Each time 1 point of Deathmark is consumed, the entire team gains 4% Crit DMG for 15 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. This bonus is 8% for Yoruichi.
corePassives.name: Force Tactic

skills.description:
Soi Fon releases Hakuda in quick succession, striking 5 times for a total damage equal to 945% of ATK while building her Spiritual Pressure. When releasing the 3rd and 4th hits, Soi Fon gains 1 point of Deathmark. ~~Time's Up~~ At max Spiritual Pressure, release the 2nd hit or later of Basic Attack 
 Soi Fon cuts into the enemy with Suzumebachi, dealing total damage equal to 465% of ATK and inflicting Homonka. If the enemy is already marked with Homonka, the attack deals 232.5% of ATK as damage, consumes the mark and deals an extra 275% of ATK as Sting DMG. The first teammate switched in within 8 seconds after releasing the attack will automatically perform their counterattack. The counterattack's damage and Spiritual Pressure Reduction Rate are reduced by 50%. ~~Windmill~~ Release Basic Attack after a Perfect Dodge, or by tapping Soi Fon's icon after a teammate's Perfect Dodge 
 Soi Fon teleports in front of the enemy and delivers a series of kicks, dealing damage equal to 157.5% of ATK and gaining 4 points of Deathmark. ~~Back Strike~~ Tap Basic Attack after releasing Windmill 
 Soi Fon teleports behind the enemy and releases a rapid combo, dealing damage equal to 157.5% of ATK and gaining 4 points of Deathmark. 
 After releasing Back Strike, tap Basic Attack to immediately release the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.
skills.name: Real Assassination

skills.description:
Soi Fon charges at the enemy and releases a dazzling barrage of attacks, dealing damage equal to 1772.5% of ATK and gaining 4 points of Deathmark. 
 After releasing a technique, tap Basic Attack to immediately release the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.
skills.name: Execution Battle

skills.description: Soi Fon releases her Bankai and fires the devastating Jakuho Raikoben at the enemy, dealing damage equal to 6010% of ATK.
skills.name: Bankai - Jakuho Raikoben

skills.description: After releasing Bakudo Number 30: Shitotsusansen to restrain the enemy, Soi Fon teleports in front of them and delivers a rapid combo, dealing damage equal to 1510% of ATK and gaining 4 points of Deathmark.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
~~While the Battlefield Skill is active, all characters in the team gain 40% increased Strike DMG.~~ 
 
 Soi Fon's Battlefield Skill uses two types of energy: Deathmark and Battlefield Skill Energy, which correspond to the two different Battlefield Skills, Combo Attack and Twin-Strike Execution. Soi Fon gain Battlefield Skill Energy by consuming Deathmark. 
 Soi Fon enters the battlefield with full Battlefield Skill Energy. ~~Combo Attack~~ When Deathmark is available 
 When another teammate lands a hit, if Battlefield Skill Energy is not full, 1 point of Deathmark is automatically consumed to trigger Soi Fon's combo attack, dealing damage equal to 95% of Soi Fon's ATK and granting 1 Battlefield Skill Energy. ~~Twin-Strike Execution~~ When Battlefield Skill Energy is at maximum 
 Soi Fon teleports to the enemy and pierces them with Suzumebachi. If the enemy is not affected by Homonka, it deals damage equal to 1887.5% of ATK and inflicts Homonka. If the enemy is already affected by Homonka, it deals damage equal to 1655% of ATK and triggers one instance of Sting equal to 275% of ATK instead, while consuming Homonka. 
 After releasing the Battlefield Skill, Soi Fon can manually release her counterattack.
skills.name: Stealth Force's Battle

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Soi Fon gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Flash Step
